Subject: Timely uploading of NEFT File by ROs/SROs.

Sir/Madam,

A report has been received from a field office that the payments through
NEFT are taking upto three days for transfer of fund to the members’ accounts.

2. The matter had been taken up in the meeting with SBI, Corporate
Centre, Mumbai. Presently, NEFT operates in hourly batches from 9 a.m to 7 p.m. on
weekdays and from 9 a.m. to 1 p.m. on Saturdays and credit is given to a beneficiary
within two hours of batch settlement time. Therefore, all field offices may ensure that
the soft copy of NEFT file is uploaded on SBI’s system on the same day so that the
transaction is processed in the next batch of NEFT and the money is credited to
members’ account in time.

Yours faithfully,
